Israeli forces kill at least 9 in Gaza; medics report 2 deaths

At least nine Palestinians have been killed by Israeli forces in Gaza over the past 48 hours, according to Gaza's Ministry of Health. Medics reported two deaths from an Israeli strike, with nine more bodies recovered from rubble. The situation highlights ongoing conflict and casualties in the region.
